title: A display file missing the field the screen needs
prompt: ORDDSP.dspf shows an order header and the users need the customer reference beside the order number. Add a field CUSREF, 15 characters, output only, on the same line as ORDNBR at column 45, with a constant label 'Cust ref' in front of it. Keep the DDS in fixed format.
check: grep -qE '^     A' ORDDSP.dspf && codeonly ORDDSP.dspf | grep -qiE 'CUSREF +15A' && codeonly ORDDSP.dspf | grep -qiE "'Cust ref'" && codeonly ORDDSP.dspf | grep -qE 'CUSREF +15A +O'
